collectionMethod: Manual capture around 10:40 Beijing time / 02:40Z on 2026-11-25 of the official OpenCode Go documentation page (https://opencode.ai/docs/go/, which 301-redirects to /docs/console/go/), the Go landing page (https://opencode.ai/go, which 302-redirects to /console/go), the documentation markdown export (https://opencode.ai/docs/console/go.md), the v2 documentation page (https://opencode.ai/v2/docs/console/go), the OpenCode console changelog RSS feed (https://opencode.ai/console/changelog/rss.xml) and the full model catalog endpoint referenced by the documentation (https://opencode.ai/inference/go/v1/models). All surfaces were compared against the 2026-11-24 captures of the same URLs. Every price, limit, estimate and sentence below is transcribed as published, and the models API entry was read field by field against the landing page and the documentation. Research-only — no adopted row generated, no adopted value changed, no script changed, no chart or site change.
scope: OpenCode Go official catalog only. The change on 2026-11-25 is that a new free limited-time model 'HungerG Free' (model id hungerg-free) appeared in the official OpenCode Go catalog: a new entry in the models API, a new row in the Go landing-page model table carrying the 'New' and 'Limited time' labels, a landing-page announcement banner 'HungerG is now available in Go', and two new sentences in the official documentation. The models API catalog moved 36 → 37 entries and the landing-page counter moved 'View all 31 models' → 'View all 32 models'. This is a free, time-limited entry with no dollar price and no monthly allowance, so it is recorded here as evidence only. No leaderboard/score data, no adopted.csv row, no computed allowance, no script change in this file.
adoptionStatus: research-only; not adopted; no opencode_go × hungerg-free row in adopted.csv yet — adding one requires an OPENCODE_GO_MODELS entry in scripts/build_adopted.py, left to maintainer review

freeModel.nameNote: The models API, the Go landing page and the official documentation all publish the same display name 'HungerG Free'.
freeModel.entryTypeNote: This is a free, time-limited catalog entry, not a paid row. The entry therefore carries no dollar allowance and is recorded here as evidence only.

freeModel.familyNote: The models API publishes no family field for this entry.
freeModel.vendorNote: The models API publishes no vendor field for this entry, and neither the landing page nor the documentation states a vendor name. No vendor is derived or invented here.

freeModel.descriptionSource: models API description field, transcribed verbatim
freeModel.modalitiesNote: Transcribed exactly as the models API publishes them, including the per-format media types. These are not collapsed into a generic 'image' or 'video' value, and no format is added or removed.

threePartPrice.cacheWriteNote: The models API cost.text block for hungerg-free has no cache write key at all — the key is absent, not an explicit 0 and not a dash on the page. Cache write price is therefore not published for this entry and is recorded as absent rather than as 0.

None of the six appears in the /go landing-page coding model table on 2026-11-25.

computationNote: This file computes no monthlyYi, no blended per-MTok price, no mixed unit price, no derived allowance and no adopted value; all numbers are transcribed as published on the models API, the Go landing page and the official documentation. The ∞ signs published for HungerG Free are kept as published and are not converted into a dollar amount, and the absent cache write key is recorded as absent rather than as 0. The model-count change is stated as the published list lengths observed in the two captures, not as a computed adopted quantity.
